AboutStatsSection.aboutTitle: Wong & Partners: Your Trusted Immigration & Business Law Team
AboutStatsSection.aboutDescriptionOne: Wong & Partners is a family-founded law firm with deep roots in the communities we serve. With over two decades of experience, our multilingual team provides clear, client-focused legal guidance in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin. Licensed across the U.S., Hong Kong, and China, we are dedicated to delivering results with integrity and expertise.
AboutStatsSection.aboutDescriptionTwo: Our practice areas include the EB-5 Investor Program, immigration, asset protection and estate planning, business entities and corporate governance, e-commerce and intellectual property, and business transactions. We are committed to helping individuals, families, and businesses achieve their goals with personalized strategies and a global perspective.

KeyValuesSection.extensiveExperienceDescription: We take pride in providing comprehensive legal advice and services, whether your needs involve business law, international transactions, intellectual property, asset protection, or immigration matters.
KeyValuesSection.globalPerspectiveDescription: With lawyers licensed in the U.S., England & Wales, Hong Kong, and China, we address legal matters with a broad and informed outlook.
KeyValuesSection.internationalSupportDescription: Our multilingual team, fluent in English, Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese, ensures clear and effective communication with a diverse client base.
